name: micp-biosafety-environment-auditor
title: MICP 生物安全与环境风险审计器

tools.name: audit
tools.purpose: Full biosafety & environmental audit of a MICP sand-column/field plan: hazards, nitrogen balance, waste streams, regulatory context, monitoring, control, residual risk, approval gates, stop conditions, emergency actions

tools.name: mass-balance
tools.purpose: Urea -> total-N -> NH4+ -> NH3 nitrogen mass balance with conservation gating (MBS-E301)

tools.name: nh3-speciation
tools.purpose: Free NH3 fraction/concentration vs pH, temperature, ionic strength (Davies + Bates-Pinching)

tools.name: strain-verify
tools.purpose: Strain identity verification + biosafety classification; never defaults a common MICP strain to safe

tools.name: regulatory-lookup
tools.purpose: Verified local regulation/limit lookup; failure marks REGULATORY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, never fabricates

tools.name: monitoring
tools.purpose: Monitoring thresholds, alarm rules, stop-condition evaluation

tools.name: treatment-compare
tools.purpose: Waste-treatment option comparison; high-residual-NH3 routes never greenlit

tools.name: emergency
tools.purpose: Emergency-response checklist generation from site profile + alarms

tools.name: permit-check
tools.purpose: Permit/approval status checker; missing approvals force HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED
